_comment: WARNING: deploy.startCommand uses `prisma db push --accept-data-loss`. If you ever rename or drop a column in schema.prisma, the deployed DB on the /data volume will silently lose data. The cluster window re-hydrates from RTDS within ~10 min, so the risk is minor, but switch to `prisma migrate deploy` before storing anything you can't lose. Railway ignores unknown top-level keys.

build.buildCommand: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm prisma generate && pnpm build

deploy.startCommand: pnpm prisma db push --skip-generate --accept-data-loss && pnpm start
